info.title: 低空无人机路径规划算法接口
info.description:
WGS84/WKT 地理坐标路径规划、连续时空避碰与航线验证。

- 场景登记：`POST /api/v2/scenes`
- 单任务规划：`POST /api/v2/plan/single`
- 多机批量规划：`POST /api/v2/plan/batch`
- 航线合法性校验：`POST /api/v2/validate`
- 异步作业：`POST /api/v2/jobs` + `GET /api/v2/jobs/{job_id}`

字段含义、单位与调用示例见仓库 `docs/API.md`。

origin_alt_ellipsoid.title: Origin Alt Ellipsoid
origin_alt_ellipsoid.description: WGS84 ellipsoid height (EG) of the local origin, metres. local z = EG - origin_alt_ellipsoid.

mass_kg.title: Mass Kg
mass_kg.description: Total moving mass in kg, including payload, supplied by the caller.

EnergyModel.title: EnergyModel
EnergyModel.description: Caller supplied engineering model; powers include baseline propulsion.

HeightCorrection.title: HeightCorrection
HeightCorrection.description: Pressure correction: EG ellipsoid altitude = reported altitude + offset_m.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: Unit of the integrated objective (values.cost times metres or seconds).

description.title: Description
description.default: Pareto comparison covers independently validated candidates generated by a finite lattice search. Labels use incoming direction and rebuilt motion costs for candidate pruning.

content.title: Content
content.description: Rule parameters. HEIGHT_LAYER defaults to EG metres; WIDTH.width is full width in metres; DIRECTION.directions uses north=0 degrees clockwise; TIME.weekdays uses Sunday=0, Monday=1 through Saturday=6.

scope.description: Rule application geometry in WGS84/EG. Missing scope applies to the scene. Grid indices require scene.grid geometry metadata.

network_version.title: Network Version
network_version.description: Upstream airway network version; separate from the compiled scene content version.
